verdicts.reason: A moves the logo to the top right, where it floats with no anchor: it doesn't line up with the right edge, the product or the quote. The product is also pushed off the circle's upper-left rim, so the circle no longer frames it, and the attribution sits close to the bottom edge. B keeps the original's structure: logo bottom-left, quote and attribution aligned on one left edge, and the product framed inside the purple circle. Its flaws are a small product with an almost illegible SOLSTICE label and a thin attribution line.
